en: Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a rural mountain scene. In the foreground and left side there is a dense forest of conifer trees; to the right are open rolling meadows leading up to a small group of alpine-style houses or guesthouses lined along a slope. Behind them rise wooded hills. Printed German text at the top right identifies the locality in the Eastern Ore Mountains and its elevation.
